en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural village scene with a pond or spring-fed pool in the foreground where many ducks or geese are swimming. On the opposite bank stand several modest two‑storey houses with gabled roofs, trees, and a wooden fence. A man walks along the left bank. The caption at the bottom in German reads "Gruss aus Luppa." and "Quellteich", with a publisher line mentioning Paul Lehr in Dahlem.
